publications.title: Author of Research Paper - Impact of COVID-19 on the Education and Health of Students
publications.subtitle: IEEE
publications.description: - Ascertained the impact of COVID-19 on the Health and Education of students across the world under a Computer Science PhD Professor from India.- Collected raw information for 300 people across different countries via surveys, cleansed data via models created in Excel, analyzed data via visualizations created in Excel, performed descriptive analysis, and presented and published paper in the 6th IEEE Conference

projects.title: ActSignLearn (Uncommon Hacks 2026)
projects.description: - Built ActSignLearn, an AI-powered ASL learning platform featuring real-time hand tracking via MediaPipe (21 landmarks/frame), a TensorFlow.js sign classifier, and a per-joint feedback engine using cosine similarity - all running entirely in the browser with no server latency.- Engineered gesture-based navigation and a personalized AI study plan agent (Groq API) that adapts to each learner's background and goals, enabling full mouse-free accessibility and a tailored week-by-week curriculum from onboarding quiz responses.

projects.title: Flixr: Netflix Ratings Extension
projects.description: - Developed and published Flixr, a privacy-focused Chrome extension that integrates IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes ratings into the Netflix UI with a toggle-able, minimalist design.- Built a Vercel-hosted backend with a custom caching layer to fetch movie metadata from third-party APIs, ensuring instant rating loads while minimizing external API calls.

projects.title: Symbiote (HackIllinois 2026 MLH Winner)
projects.description: - Engineered a multimodal AI inspection pipeline using Gemini Live voice-to-action and Qwen2-VL-7B (via reference-grounded prompting) to automate 20-minute safety checks in <60 seconds.- Architected a React data governance dashboard and Supabase backend to transform raw voice/vision inputs into structured, audit-ready datasets with timestamps, fleet health metrics, and automated procurement status.

projects.title: WeatherVerse Web App
projects.description: • Developed a secure, scalable full-stack web app that supports CRUD operations for managing “circles” of contacts, visualized as personalized avatars on an interactive world map showing real-time weather and local time.• Architected backend schemas and RESTful APIs with JWT authentication and middleware-based security; integrated multiple external APIs, implemented WebSocket-driven real-time updates, and developed personalized notifications to deliver a responsive and user-centric experience.

projects.title: CircleSync Web App
projects.description: - Developed a social web app to connect U of I students with their peers for activities like studying, clubs, and making friends to easily transition from high school to college for DevAda in Women in Computer Science.- Directed the front-end development process, employing React and JavaScript frameworks to create and provide an intuitive user experience with seamless navigation between groups.

projects.title: DartFrog Web App
projects.description: - Deployed an AI data analysis tool capable of accepting uploaded CSV files, conducting comprehensive analysis, and generating insightful summaries and statistical graphs with a team of 4 at HackIllinois.- Engineered Python parsers for CSV, XML, and JSON files as well as led prompt engineering efforts to refine the Gemini model, enabling accurate extraction of key insights and trends.

projects.title: Cricket Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: - Personal Project- Analyzed Cricket players from across the world to create an undefeatable team of 11 via SQL and a Power BI Dashboard.- Extracted necessary data and performed data transformation in Power Query – delimiters, trimming text, and creating and adding custom and conditional columns. Performed data modelling using DAX Queries to create relationships between tables, write and create calculated measures/columns.- Designed an interactive Dashboard via pages, matrixes, buttons, slicers, forecasting, and data bars.

projects.title: Sleep Safe Web App
projects.description: - Designed a hardware device, using Arduino, to help record sleep patterns and noninvasively diagnose cases of breathing issues during sleep with a team of 5 for the Neev Hackathon held in India.- Executed Python libraries to train dataset and improve the efficiency of the machine learning model and ran JavaScript files to develop a simplistic frontend. Loaded project files onto device.

projects.title: Sleepy Driver Detector
projects.description: - Personal Project - Analyzed trends in car accidents across the world caused by drivers falling asleep behind the wheel and designed a sleepy driver detection software.- Developed a machine learning model using Python scripts and libraries and trained it using the 80:20 ratio after capturing the number of blinks in a frame in one second. Alarmed the driver by sounding a loud alarm if eyes were closed for more than three seconds.
